proposal.summary: The report describes an SQL injection in DataEase v.1.18.9 that allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information by supplying a crafted string that bypasses a blacklist function.
proposal.cwe_quote: SQL injection vulnerability in DataEase v.1.18.9 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via a crafted string outside of the blacklist function.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request full technical details and a proof-of-concept from the reporter (affected endpoints, example payloads, and whether authentication is required); reproduce the issue in a controlled test environment and identify all affected query parameters and code paths to prepare a patch.

evidence_quotes.quote: SQL injection vulnerability in DataEase v.1.18.9 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via a crafted string outside of the blacklist function.
